purpose: Authoring inventory for factual coverage. It maps factual families to real profile consumers; it neither authorizes presence nor defines an action, item, recipe, NPC, or location whitelist.
claim_coverage_rule: Every production claim is explicitly classified into one or more semantic families with location and resource/material/process/NPC applicability. Domain rollups and source inventory are informational cross-checks, not substitutes for family classification. Coverage of existing claims is not completeness of all gameplay knowledge.

gameplay_need_cartography.purpose: Open-RPG need-first map: approved families classify current support; missing_families records independently identified unmet or partial needs, including potential consumers beyond current scenes. Fragment reconciliation below is inventory only, not the origin or boundary of needs. No action, item, recipe or room-content whitelist.
gameplay_need_cartography.blind_spot_method: External cross-domain classifications may challenge this map and reveal omitted gameplay needs, but never serve as evidence for a Novgorod fact. Each resulting production claim still requires its own source and independent verification.
gameplay_need_cartography.potential_consumer_policy: potential: references are design applicability, never existing exports, active bindings, runtime permission or scene presence. Lack of a current consumer does not exclude a plausible open-RPG factual need from static research.
gameplay_need_cartography.phase: static source-backed coverage; live exploration, owner repair, replay and saturation belong to a separately authorized future gameplay-testing phase
